name: Carl Schmitt
shortBio: German jurist and political philosopher who formulated legal decisionism, defining sovereignty through the state of exception and the political through the friend-enemy distinction.
centralQuestion: Can a constitutional legal order sustain itself purely through abstract procedural norms, or does authentic political authority always rest on a sovereign decision during an existential exception?

keyWorks.title: Political Theology: Four Chapters on the Concept of Sovereignty
keyWorks.description: Foundational treatise arguing that modern state concepts are secularized theological concepts and defining the sovereign through the exception.

keyWorks.title: The Concept of the Political
keyWorks.description: Seminal essay defining the autonomous sphere of politics through the existential distinction between friend and enemy.

keyWorks.title: The Nomos of the Earth
keyWorks.description: Historical and jurisprudence inquiry into the spatial constitution of international law (jus publicum Europaeum) and global order.
